name: Botanic Forest
tagline: Deep forest-green gradient with a warm sunset glow, gold italic serif accents, mono labels and layered mountain silhouettes (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: forest-green night gradient with warm orange sun glow, pale sage text and gold italic highlights

typography.style: refined text serif with gold italic emphasis, neutral Inter body and tracked monospace labels

best_for: Story-led talks about places, nature, brands with a field or craft side, and sustainability. Big serif headlines on a dark green ground feel calm and cinematic.
avoid_for: Dense data reviews or bright, upbeat product launches where the dark, quiet mood works against the message.
